Hi Sofia / OrbitCorp AP team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To keep the vendor enrollment moving, please confirm the following so Redwood can submit the supplier packet into your portal this week: 

- PO number placement: does OrbitCorp require a PO number on the invoice header and in the PDF filename? If so, preferred format (e.g., ORB-2027-XXXXX).
- Required invoice fields: we can include line-level commodity codes and your internal Chart of Accounts (CoA) if needed — confirm whether line-level accounting is mandatory.
- Remit instructions: SEPA/ACH/EFT preferred field names (Beneficiary name, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, bank address).
- Tax / VAT evidence: for EU invoices, please confirm if a validated EU VAT number (VIES check) is required on submission or if self-attestation is acceptable for new vendors. Also, is a W-9 required for US entities?
- Payment terms & currency mapping: Net 30 default is fine; advise if you require Net 45/60 for initial orders and which currency the PO will be issued in (USD / EUR / GBP).
- Vendor ID / portal credentials: what fields are mandatory in the portal (company legal name, DBA, tax ID, email for remittance, contact person)?

I've attached a one-page "supplier enrollment evidence matrix" that maps each field we typically provide to the supporting doc (invoice sample, bank proof, VAT cert). If you can confirm the must-haves, I'll populate the portal and upload the attachments.

Attachments: supplier_enrollment_matrix.xlsx (matrix), sample_invoice_us.pdf (sample invoice with PO), bank_account_proof.pdf (bank letter)

Next steps: Please reply with a checklist or a short screenshot of the portal field names we should populate. If helpful, I can also provide a DocuSign packet for W-9 / EU forms.

Hi Marcus — thanks for the thorough list. Quick answers inline: 

- PO number: Yes, PO must be on the invoice header and included in the PDF filename (format ORB-YYYY-#####).
- Invoice fields: Line-level accounting is optional for services but required for hardware/product POs. If the PO has multiple billing account codes, include a CSV line mapping.
- Remit instructions: We prefer ACH for US, SEPA for EU. Required fields: Beneficiary name, Account number/IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, Bank name. Bank address optional.
- Tax/VAT evidence: For EU vendors VAT number with VIES check is required for VAT-exempt B2B invoices; otherwise, provide a VAT registration certificate (scanned). For US vendors, W-9 is required.
- Payment terms: Standard for new suppliers is Net 45 for the first 90 days; after first two successful invoices, terms can be moved to Net 30. Currency: PO will state the currency; we support multi-currency.
- Portal mandatory fields: Legal name, Tax ID / VAT ID, Remit email, Primary AP contact name + phone, Bank details are required to enable ACH/SEPA.

We can accept the matrix — please upload to the portal or to the secure intake link. Also send the W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) via DocuSign.

I'll loop in procurement@orbitcorp.com if any fields need procurement approval.

Best,

Thanks for the heads up — quick answers: 

1) W-9: We should send the latest signed W-9 via DocuSign (best practice). Mina, can you prepare the DocuSign and attach the signed PDF to the portal upload?
2) Bank proof: bank_account_proof.pdf is acceptable for OrbitCorp's intake team as long as it shows account name + IBAN/Account number and bank logo. If they require a bank letter, Treasury can produce it; we should ask only if OrbitCorp flags it.
3) Terms: approve Net 45 for the first 90 days to expedite onboarding. Please document the terms in the mutual action plan and request that OrbitCorp include payment hold-release SLAs in the vendor notes. Also add a note to billing that PO number format must be included to avoid remittance delays.

I'll also add a compliance check: for EU invoices where we charge VAT, ensure we have either a VIES-validated VAT number for the customer or appropriate VAT treatment on the invoice lines.

Thanks — once Mina uploads the DocuSign & matrix I'll have legal/finance sign off and Marcus can submit to the portal.
